_about: Purchased parts for the mates_task brief. Dimensions in mm. Placeholders: kit_parts.py builds each in the local frame given by its "frame" line; use them unmodified (don't cut or join them): the scorer finds each one by its mesh. connectors: named frames in that local frame for cadlib.mates (mates.from_component): origin on the mating face, z out of the part, a hole pattern in minimal form (["rect", px, py], ["circle", pcd, n, a0_deg]) seen from outside the face, and the hole size.

servo.frame: origin on the spline axis at the case top; spline up +Z; case below z = 0; length along X with the case centre at x = -10

spline.note: spline top: the horn hub seats here and turns about z

horn.frame: origin on the axis at the hub underside (on the spline top); disc above; hole 0 on +X

hub.note: hub underside, on the spline top

face_4.note: disc top, every other hole (0, 90, 180, 270 deg)

pcb.what: Controller board, 50 x 40 x 1.6, 4 x M2.5 holes
pcb.frame: origin at the board underside centre; components up +Z; header block toward +X

top.note: board top: the screw heads bear here
